description: This is a Java unit test source file for the 'Delegator' class in the Apache OFBiz framework. It contains test cases verifying the creation and retrieval of 'Delegator' instances using various factory methods, as well as setup and teardown for logging configurations.

classes.name: DelegatorUnitTests
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing 'Delegator' creation and behavior in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets system properties for testing environment and disables error logging.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores the error logging setting to its previous state after tests.

methods.name: delegatorCreationUsingConstructorFailsIfConfigurationIsMissing
methods.description: Tests that constructing a 'Delegator' with missing configuration throws 'GenericEntityException'.

methods.name: delegatorCreationUsingConstructor
methods.description: Verifies that creating a 'GenericDelegator' with a valid configuration returns a non-null delegator with correct attributes.

methods.name: delegatorCreationUsingFactoryGetInstance
methods.description: Tests that 'DelegatorFactoryImpl' returns distinct instances for the same name.

methods.name: delegatorCreationUsingFactoryGetDelegator
methods.description: Tests that 'DelegatorFactory.getDelegator' returns singleton for the same name or null for missing configuration.

methods.name: delegatorCreationUsingFactoryReturnsNullIfConfigurationIsMissing
methods.description: Checks that the factory returns null when no configuration is available for the given delegator name.
